agent-waiting.alt: fuxx's sidebar: the web workspace glows pink with Claude's question and an Open button, while the api workspace sits idle

window-split.alt: A fuxx window with two panes side by side, a test run on the left and Claude working on the right

chat-select.alt: A reply in an agent tab with its heading and part of a sentence selected, ready to copy

palette.alt: The ⌘K palette searching actions, workspaces, files and settings

suggestion.alt: The agent box holding Claude’s suggested next message in grey italic, with a Tab hint, above the model menu

files-menu.alt: Right-click on a file in the Files tree: Open, Open to the Side, Add to Claude Chat, Show Changes, Reveal in Finder, Copy Path, Rename, Move to Trash
